title: Setting "Keep Screen On" to false does nothing if window is focused (even the editor)
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.2-stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable (5e984564c) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 61.61 GiB memory

### Issue description

I want to set "Keep Screen On" to off, at least in the editor. It's a crucial setting for someone with an OLED monitor.
Setting this to off did nothing. ~~I looked at the code `void DisplayServerWindows::screen_set_keep_on(bool p_enable)`. The problem is that because it's checking `if (keep_screen_on == p_enable)`, it does nothing if we set it to false (because it's already false).~~

~~I commented out this piece of code and it started working:~~
```cpp
if (keep_screen_on == p_enable) {
	return;
}
```


~~UPD: It worked for the export app, but not for the editor. Editor doesn't seem to call this function at all.~~
UPD2: Okay, commenting out this code actually did nothing. It turns out, the screen will turn off if the app/editor is not focused. However, I would like for it to work even when focused... maybe a separate setting?

### Steps to reproduce

1. Set "Keep Screen On" to off in the project settings
2. Set screen off timeout in Windows to 1 minute
3. Run you app and wait 1 minute
4. Screen doesn't go off

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
